global_budget.title: Paid work has reached a budget limit
global_budget.detail: New work may need to wait for the next UTC budget window. Increase limits only if you choose to spend more; saved content remains available.

review_budget.title: Report review has reached its budget limit
review_budget.detail: The review allowance cannot cover more work or the last scheduled assessment. Reports stay queued. You can wait for the next UTC window or choose to increase the review budget within the overall limit.

billing_uncertain.title: A provider charge needs reconciliation
billing_uncertain.detail: An outcome or charge is unknown. Its reservation stays held. Check provider billing and saved job evidence before any recovery; do not resubmit the request.

generation_stalled.title: Translation or Study work appears interrupted
generation_stalled.detail: A request has remained unfinished for more than ten minutes. Check its state and provider evidence. Existing reservations remain held and no duplicate request is started.

review_batch_stalled.title: A review batch has been unfinished for over 48 hours
review_batch_stalled.detail: Check the provider batch and worker evidence before input and output files expire. Do not clear reservations or resubmit work without confirming its outcome.

review_worker_failure.title: The report worker needs attention
review_worker_failure.detail: The last run failed or has an unresolved provider or storage outcome. Check the worker status and deployment logs. Routine semantic uncertainty does not require your review.

safety_pause.title: Paid work is paused after a provider safety check
safety_pause.detail: A recorded cost overrun or unexpected provider configuration needs investigation. Verify billing and configuration before resuming; resuming does not increase limits.

scheduler_overdue.title: The scheduled alert check is overdue
scheduler_overdue.detail: No completed alert check has been recorded for over 36 hours. Check the Vercel cron configuration and deployment logs. A stopped scheduler cannot send its own failure alert.
